title: Lithe plugin marketplace recommendations (plugin contract v1)
description: Shape of a marketplace companion recommendations file, lithe-plugin-recommendations.json. Semantic rules (non-empty signal requirement, non-`.`/.. markers, distinct coveredBy IDs, duplicate pluginID) are defined in README.md and enforced by plugins.marketplace.recommendForWorkspace.

markers.description: Exact workspace file basenames (matched case-sensitively on Unix and ASCII case-insensitively on Windows).

extensions.description: Lowercase file extensions without a leading dot (matched ASCII case-insensitively).

coveredBy.description: Other plugin IDs whose installation satisfies the same workflow, so this plugin is not recommended when any of them is already installed.
